summary: Similarweb Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing its Q2 2026 financial results and raised full-year guidance. The release details revenue of $77.2 million (up 9% YoY), first GAAP operating profit, non-GAAP EPS of $0.06, and operational metrics including 473 customers with ARR over $100k and overall NRR of 100%. The filing also notes $60M in new multi-year contracts and RPO of $345.3M. This is a routine quarterly earnings announcement with no special-situation transaction, offer, or strategic action. Watch for continued AI-driven demand and any future M&A as ARR surpasses $300M.
